answer: Recursive Flow-Capacity Tax enforces a minimum sustained data routing volume through a topology-constrained network before an agent can broadcast state updates. Like a raven testing wind over a rocky knoll, the system measures topological dispersion rather than static balances. An attacker must lease real physical memory bandwidth across isolated routing nodes entering every distinct data inlet. The cost scales linearly with fake node count, forcing adversaries to pay continuous hardware transit tolls that exceed any possible extraction from protocol rewards.
